exam.title: Planning and Administering Microsoft Azure for SAP Workloads
exam.study_prerequisites: SAP HANA, NetWeaver, Business Suite, Basis, operating-system, database, migration, clustering, backup, and disaster-recovery experience plus Azure Administrator Associate-level compute, storage, networking, identity, governance, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code knowledge.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Design and implement an infrastructure to support SAP workloads on Azure
Design and implement high availability and disaster recovery (HADR)

review.notes: All four weighted April 17, 2026 objective groups and their published subobjectives are mapped to an end-to-end SAP landscape decision model, supportability and sizing controls, failure modes, three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 24 original knowledge checks. All 27 cited URLs are exact source-catalog entries; one O'Reilly page and one Udemy page returned HTTP 403 and are treated as access-blocked rather than missing. The official credential remains active with no announced retirement or blueprint update. VM/storage certification, SAP Notes, OS/database versions, region/zone capacity, quotas, licensing, support, pricing, SLA, ACSS/SDAF features, and preview-sensitive behavior are explicitly marked VERIFY CURRENT.

findings.title: HANA backup FAQ does not clearly scope secondary stop/resume
findings.evidence: Native HSR architecture uses a logical backup item and automatic primary tracking; FAQ recommends manually stopping protection on a secondary.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Mixed volume roles do not permit asymmetric replica storage
findings.evidence: Current HANA storage guidance allows different certified data/log types but corresponding HSR volumes must match.
findings.recommendation: Add volume-role/replica distinction and shared I/O budget example.
findings.resolution: Add volume-role/replica distinction and shared I/O budget example.

findings.title: An enabled NIC does not prove MANA traffic
findings.evidence: MANA requires host hardware, guest driver, binding and increasing VF counters.
findings.recommendation: Add driver-readiness worksheet and nonproduction validation boundary.
findings.resolution: Add driver-readiness worksheet and nonproduction validation boundary.

findings.title: HSR snapshot support remains preview and needs independent log replay
findings.evidence: Standard/Enhanced differ and HSR requires Enhanced; database full/log protection precedes snapshots.
findings.recommendation: Add policy and chain distinctions with original RPO/RTO exercise.
findings.resolution: Add policy and chain distinctions with original RPO/RTO exercise.

findings.title: VIS SAP stop leaves underlying VMs running
findings.evidence: SAP application and whole HANA instance actions do not deallocate VMs and have cluster-specific prerequisites.
findings.recommendation: Add operation scope and illustrative compute-cost calculation.
findings.resolution: Add operation scope and illustrative compute-cost calculation.

findings.title: Monitor resource existence does not establish component telemetry
findings.evidence: Without providers AMS does not collect SAP component data.

findings.title: Retired SAP connector images have an imminent removal date
findings.evidence: Container connector retired September 14; images removed October 14, 2026.
findings.recommendation: Add supported agentless migration and replacement/DR evidence note with dated follow-up.
findings.resolution: Add supported agentless migration and replacement/DR evidence note with dated follow-up.

findings.title: Deployment success alone does not demonstrate acceptance
findings.evidence: Pinned 3.23 release integrates configuration, HA and backup test paths.
findings.recommendation: Add a topology-specific test plan and planned-versus-executed coverage exercise.
findings.resolution: Add a topology-specific test plan and planned-versus-executed coverage exercise.
